scripts.features:
Features and Functionalities:

Speed Boost: Instantly increase your character’s running speed to gain a competitive advantage.

Auto Win: Automates winning races, letting you collect rewards effortlessly.

Customizable Controls: Modify the script to adjust the speed and features according to your preferences.

Anti-Cheat Protection: Safe to use with most Roblox anti-cheat systems, minimizing the risk of detection.

Easy Setup: Simple to apply and start using in any racing game.

comments.text: I'm tired of key checkpoints. There's not much player in this game, and three checkpoints for this script is too much. I just want to have fun with the script. Don't mind me, I don't think it's worth it.
